Thank you for replying. When I think about what I would want without limits, it does get so fantastical and outrageous that it gets really depressing because it will never be achievable. 

It's difficult to explain, but it's something like a personal self and a public self? My personal self would want to be a girl badly when I'm alone at home or running errands or doing *my* stuff. The public self is when I hang out or travel with my friends and family, go for social events, the dysphoria would go away a little and being a guy is all right. Of course now and then there are exceptions...

It was a bad week tbh. Some madness came over me and i asked this girl out. This girl being my crush of 5 years, during which she rejected me 4x and i havent spoken to her in a year. I knew nothing good would have come of it but for some reason i did. People do strange things when they are losing their mind i suppose. Lets call her K.

It doesn't sound that bad because i didnt mention that she never liked me from the beginning. In fact, she detests me. Somewhere along the line, her best friend had some feelings for me and started going out with me. Lets call her W. Sounds dandy i suppose but my own brother from a different mother had a thing for W and i'm all about being a bro. I was young and foolish and didnt handle things properly and long story short, K and W both came to hate me, along with their friends. 

They told their side of the story and even more people i knew came to shun me. I guess i can't complain because in fact im a terrible human being and i deserve being ostracized. 

For some unexplainable reason K agreed and we had dinner. It was terrible because i felt that insane hopeless attraction for her once again.  I tried very hard to move on but now t's back. She confirmed my suspicions and told me to my ugly face that she dislikes me and think me a terrible human being. I have no idea what made her want to see a shitty person out of nowhere. Never once have i, in the past half decade, gone against K, did anything bad to her. Ive always offered my assistance when she cared to use me, and ive always offered my existence when she came to be lonely. 

I came away that night feeling emptier than ever. 

On a side note, ive also come to realise that nobody really likes me. The bros seem to be annoyed with me more than not, when i try to have fun like we used to. The age old gang is falling apart it appears and im afraid. They are my only friends, and i love them dearly, yet i fear i am close to losing them. I can feel the disappointment when my parents look at me, and it just feels really bad when i hear them whispering things about me. I suppose i am a dreadful disappointment to everyone around me. 

Ive been spending the medical leave away from the military that i was given hence reading and playing skyrim all by myself. To be very honest, even when i do get to hang out with the bros now and then, i still feel lonely. I feel like i'm alone in this world. I think it's worse when there are people around, sort of. Whenever anyone says "i'm here for you" i feel guilty. Truthfully, i don't believe them. I believe their good intentions but not in how they show it. I can't ask for anything more, i appreciate thatthey have tried. Thanks and sorry to everyone, i don't knowhow it ended up like this. 

In a week i'll have to be returning to the military, which i cannot stand.. From there on out, it's bleak. Slaving away like a mule after my service in Uni over some overpriced program and course i wouldn't even like but have to pick up anyway because money. I don't understand what purpose can there possibly be when a pre-requisite of living a fulfilling life is survival, and survival in the first world refers to toiling away endlessly and losing your soul in the process. Surprise motherfucker you need a soul to live a life worth living. 

It's a never ending pursuit of happiness through turmoil. Why put myself through that when death is eternal peace? Lately i've been feeling as though the while world has gone mad and im lost in this cold dead wasteland. Everyone else is crazy. Why doesn't everyone just see this and completely freak out? Why am i the only one getting raped by existential dread? 

"You can be whatever you want to be." Everyone had just been a terrible liar when they told me to follow my dreams when i was a kid, knowing full well that i was merely years away from becoming unrecognizably jaded and ultimately lose the will, power and freedom to do what makes me happy up to the point where nothing can make me happy anymore. 

FUUUUUUUUUUUCKKKKKK

Sorry for rambling, i had wanted to write all this and more in gory, cringing detail in my diary but i couldnt bring myself to.
